meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,当你要接 Telegram 频道时,Claude 会复制并注册 Telegram 接入模块、安装固定版本依赖、构建验证,然后引导你在 BotFather 创建机器人、获取令牌并完成配对,最后让服务加载生效。
howto.when: 当用户要求通过 Chat SDK 添加 Telegram 频道集成时触发。常见说法包括“接入 Telegram”“添加 Telegram bot”或运行 add-telegram 指令。

say.text: 帮我接入 Telegram 频道
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加流程,如复制代码、安装依赖。

say.text: 添加 Telegram bot 集成
say.note: Claude 会询问 bot token 并继续配置。

say.text: 我想连接 Telegram 机器人
say.note: 若尚未创建 bot,会指引你去 BotFather 创建。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask to add Telegram, Claude copies and registers the Telegram adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and validates, then guides you through BotFather bot creation, token setup, and pairing, then restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK, e.g., saying "integrate Telegram", "add a Telegram bot", or invoking add-telegram.

say_en.text: Help me connect to Telegram channel

say_en.note: Prompts for the bot token and proceeds.

say_en.text: I want to link my Telegram bot
say_en.note: If no bot yet, directs you to BotFather.
